ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The next window is a square of area $1 \mathrm{~m}^{2}$ and is composed of four triangles, which areas, indicated in the figure, follow the ratios $3 A=4 B$ and $2 C=3 D$. A fly is placed exactly at the point where these four triangles touch each other. The fly flies directly to the side closest to the window. How much does it fly?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a square window. An interior red point is connected to all four corners, dividing the square into four triangles. The left triangle is labeled A, the right triangle B, the top triangle C, and the bottom triangle D. Thus A uses the full left side of the square as its base, B uses the full right side, C uses the full top side, and D uses the full bottom side. Reasoning: The square has area 1 m^2, so its side length is 1 m. Let the perpendicular distances from the red point to the left, right, top, and bottom sides be l, r, t, and b. Since each triangle has base 1 m, their areas are A = l/2, B = r/2, C = t/2, and D = b/2. Also l + r = 1 and t + b = 1. From 3A = 4B, we get 3(l/2) = 4(r/2), so 3l = 4r. With l + r = 1, this gives l = 4/7 and r = 3/7. From 2C = 3D, we get 2(t/2) = 3(b/2), so 2t = 3b. With t + b = 1, this gives t = 3/5 and b = 2/5. The closest side is the minimum of 4/7, 3/7, 3/5, and 2/5 meters, which is 2/5 m = 40 cm.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a square whose four corners are joined to the interior red point, creating four triangles: A has the left side of the square as its base, B has the right side as base, C has the top side as base, and D has the bottom side as base. From the text, the square has area 1 m^2, so its side length is 1 m, and the area relations are 3A=4B and 2C=3D. Let the perpendicular distances from the red point to the left, right, top, and bottom sides be l, r, t, b. Since each triangle uses a full side of the square as base, A=l/2, B=r/2, C=t/2, D=b/2, with l+r=1 and t+b=1. Use 3A=4B to get 3l=4r, so l=4/7 and r=3/7. Use 2C=3D to get 2t=3b, so t=3/5 and b=2/5. The closest side is the minimum of 4/7, 3/7, 3/5, 2/5 meters, which is 2/5 m = 40 cm.
